about.description: Source claim, question or evidence concerns the target domain anchor; no assertion of truth or implication.

answers.description: Claim offers full, partial or unknown coverage of a question. Only a current accepted full answer resolves it; partial answers preserve the remainder.

challenges.description: Source disputes or supplies a potential counterexample to the target claim.

checks.description: A saved computation checked this input; does not imply support or acceptance.

depends-on.description: Dependent statement requires the prerequisite to hold; a semantic change to the prerequisite marks the dependent for review.

extracted-from.description: Interpretation was extracted from the source; a corrected source marks the extraction for review. The source needs no accepted standing.

governs.description: Source claim specifies a responsibility, permission or constraint concerning the target operation; conditions remain in the claim text.

informs.description: Source contributes context for the target proposal without logical entailment.

motivates.description: Source explains why the target question is worth asking; does not answer it.

potential-conflict.description: Recorded possible incompatibility between claims requiring interpretation of conditions and scope. Not proof of contradiction.

raises.description: Source gives rise to the target unresolved question.

revises.description: Source updates or corrects the target earlier formulation.

supports.description: Source supplies a reason to believe the target claim; not a proof.

case.description: An experience or case-study summary, with source provenance.

check-result.description: A reproducible bounded pattern evaluation tied to exact claim and trace inputs; not a proof of the prose theory.

claim.description: A proposition, including proposals, user-stated positions and challenged formulations; status records its standing.

entity.description: A named domain role or object type that statements refer to; subtype is recorded in metadata.

operation.description: A named action whose meaning is distinct from its permission or implementation.

question.description: An unresolved or answered inquiry; answers are linked claims.

source.description: A source artifact or provenance context.

trace.description: An explicitly bounded event trace extracted from evidence or constructed as a synthetic fixture. Roles are recorded at event time.
